scripts.check:cloudflare: node --check src/worker.js && node --check scripts/build-cloudflare.mjs && npm run build
scripts.check:cf-native: node --check cloudflare/runtime/web-worker.js && node --check scripts/build-cloudflare-native.mjs && npm run build:cf-native
scripts.dev:cf-native: npm run build:cf-native && wrangler dev --env dev --config cloudflare/runtime/wrangler.native.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cf-native:dev: npm run check:cf-native && wrangler deploy --env dev --config cloudflare/runtime/wrangler.native.jsonc
scripts.deploy:cf-native:prod: npm run check:cf-native && wrangler deploy --env production --config cloudflare/runtime/wrangler.native.jsonc
